interpretation.bounded_negative: Across every periodic Bus4 stream with enough samples for continuous-command correlation, no external-ID field reproducibly leads the EPS motor proxy, measured steering angle, or steering rate. The only reproduced angle leads are fields in 0x030, the exact F33 EPS transmit frame; this is a positive control that the method detects actuator-before-motion relationships.
interpretation.meaning: The retained logs do not reveal a second ordinary external CAN steering-target carrier. This does not prove the physical LTA actuation path is the FEBECC62/1C02 observable cone; indirect/local-RAM/peripheral paths and downstream motor-reference paths require separate firmware closure.

method.lag_convention: corr(field(t), target(t+tau)); tau>0 means field LEADS target
method.low_rate_boundary: streams below 50 frames in the Class-L+/-8s window are excluded from correlation; this excludes <=~1.5Hz traffic, not a plausible continuous EPS steering carrier
method.network: Panda bus0 on relay-correct Toyota-B = Toyota Bus4 Brake/EPS chassis network; bus2 is relay mirror
